t00: A store had 240 apples. It sold 35% on Monday and 40 more on Tuesday. How many apples remain?
t01: A tank holds 900 L. It is 2/3 full, then 150 L are added. How many liters are in the tank now?
t02: A worker earns $18/hour for 40 hours and 1.5x that rate for 6 overtime hours. What is the total pay in dollars?
t03: A rectangle is 14 m by 9 m. A 2 m wide path runs around its inside edge. What is the area of the path in square meters?
t04: Three friends split a $150 bill: Ann pays twice as much as Bo, and Cy pays $10 more than Bo. How much does Ann pay in dollars?
t05: A car travels 210 km using 15 L of fuel. At the same efficiency, how many liters are needed for 350 km?
t06: A book club read 3 books averaging 280 pages; a 4th book has 360 pages. What is the average pages across all 4 books?
t07: A phone costs $600. Its price drops 15%, then rises 10% of the new price. What is the final price in dollars?
t08: A recipe for 4 servings needs 320 g flour. How many grams are needed for 7 servings?
t09: A train leaves at 09:20 and arrives at 13:05. The trip is 300 km. What is the average speed in km/h (rounded down)?
